mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that increases the metabolism of prochlorperazine, reducing its plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced antiemetic/antipsychotic effectiveness; consider increasing prochlorperazine dose or selecting an alternative antipsychotic with less enzyme induction susceptibility; reassess dose after rifampin discontinuation.
